title: model-router availability document, format version 1
description: The document shape accepted by --availability-file. `format` is the contract version; `generatedAt` is checked against `maxAgeSeconds` from config.json. Unknown fields are ignored. A broken top level (not JSON, missing fields, or unknown format) means the CLI ranks without availability and fills `availabilityNote`. A single bad entry is skipped with a warning; the other entries still apply.

generatedAt.description: When the document was produced. Older than `maxAgeSeconds` (or unparseable) is stale and the CLI fills `availabilityNote`.

availabilityEntry.description: One meter reading. Several entries on one meter combine by worst status, then lowest `percentRemaining`.

meter.description: The meter the entry covers. Must be declared in the registry's meters section.

status.description: The worst-case state the reading reports. `ok` keeps the route in place; `projected` moves it below the healthy routes (a `spendToZero` meter keeps its place); `exhausted` removes it.

resetsAt.description: When the limiting window ends. After this, `dropExpired` removes the entry.

percentRemaining.description: Tie-breaker among same-status entries on one meter; the lowest wins.

note.description: Free-form context. The CLI keeps it on the entry but does not act on it.
